verdict.rationale: The pack's only source evidence is a first-party GitHub repository (letta-ai/letta) described as containing the Letta Agent SDK, which suggests the code is publicly readable. Nothing states which license applies or whether the full product, rather than just the SDK, is in the repo. The 'white box' community comments describe inspecting LLM requests, not source code, so they don't count here. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license, confirmation that the core product source (not just the SDK) is published, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
